g.aria-label: Subtitle text '49,615 dog intakes over 86 months. 73 of them — 0.1% — carry a behaviour-linked intake type or condition. Amber is the behaviour-linked subset; grey is everything else. The lower panel is the same subset as a percentage.'

text.tspan: 49,615 dog intakes over 86 months. 73 of them — 0.1% — carry a behaviour-linked intake type or condition.
Amber is the behaviour-linked subset; grey is everything else. The lower panel is the same subset as a percentage.

text.aria-label: t: Source: Austin Animal Center open data via REF.V_AAC_INTAKE_TREND, synced into Snowflake by scripts/austin_sync.py. First and last months dropped as partial. Behaviour-linked is a classification of AAC's own intake_type and intake_condition fields — it is not a clinical judgement and it is not evidence that pain caused any individual surrender.
text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Source: Austin Animal Center open data via REF.V_AAC_INTAKE_TREND, synced into Snowflake by scripts/austin_sync.py.
First and last months dropped as partial. Behaviour-linked is a classification of AAC's own intake_type and intake_condition fields —
it is not a clinical judgement and it is not evidence that pain caused any individual surrender.
